verdict.rationale: Dagster lets you write ingestion for any API as plain Python asset definitions and scaffold reusable Components with `dg scaffold defs`. Its dlt integration (DltLoadCollectionComponent) also gives a supported path to wrap dlt sources as assets. This is a code-first framework approach rather than a dedicated connector SDK or low-code builder, and the evidence never shows building a custom API connector end to end. Missing for 10: a dedicated connector-building framework or low-code builder documented in the pack, explicit docs on authoring a custom source for a long-tail API (auth, pagination, schema), and hands-on or independent corroboration.
